**In one line**: A US lawsuit reportedly targets OpenAI, Google and other major AI companies, alleging they suppressed competition and deliberately slowed AI development.

### Key points
- The suit reportedly names leading AI firms, including OpenAI and Google, and claims they acted to slow the pace of AI development.
- The story was reported by Indian outlet India Today.
- Specifics — the plaintiffs, the claims, and the legal basis — have not been confirmed in detail so far.

### Why it matters
It signals renewed regulatory and legal scrutiny of Big Tech's dominance in AI markets in the US. If the allegations hold up, antitrust debate could extend beyond search and advertising into the arena of AI model development itself.
